EmailTemplate.subject: CHS Online Orientation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations on your admission to ASU! The College of Health Solutions is here to help with your next steps. We are excited that you are considering ASU, but understand that you may be feeling anxious about transferring, unsure of what your next step is, and worried about how to get financial aid and register for classes. By completing the Blackboard course "College of Health Solutions Online Orientation," all of these questions and many more will be answered for you. To find this course, please follow these steps:
1. Go to my.asu.edu and log in using your ASURITE User ID and password.
2. Select the Blackboard link at the bottom of the My Classes section.
3. In the top left corner, select the Courses tab.
4. On the left-hand column, you will find a Course Search area. Search for and select College of Health Solutions Online Orientation.
5. Find and click Enroll under the drop-down arrow below Course ID to sign yourself up for the course. Next, press the red Submit button followed by the OK button on the bottom of the right side of the page.
This Blackboard course was created for you to refer to throughout your academic career at ASU. Specific tabs in this course can help you find where to park on campus, purchase football tickets, locate academic advising and more.
To get started, click each heading on the left side of the page, read all the content offered and then complete the quiz. After completing the quiz, call our academic advising office to make your advising appointment. The front desk will check to make sure you've completed the quiz before you meet your academic advisor.
You are now on your way to becoming a Sun Devil! Please let us know if you have any questions on your next steps. Welcome to the ASU family.
Sincerely,
College of Health Solutions Recruitment Team Arizona State University 602-496-0207 chs@asu.edu
